model.name: Bezaire et al. 2016 CA1 O-LM interneuron (olmcell; 8 segments in soma, 2 dendrites, axon)
model.citation: Bezaire MJ, Raikov I, Burk K, Vyas D, Soltesz I (2016). Interneuronal mechanisms of hippocampal theta oscillations in a full-scale model of the rodent CA1 circuit. eLife 5:e18566. doi:10.7554/eLife.18566
model.license: unclear (no LICENSE/LICENCE/COPYING file in the tree at this commit; GitHub licence API: none)
model.expected_behavior: Small multicompartment cell, 8 segments ("exported from NEURON ModelView"). Soma HCNolm 0.5 mS/cm2 (erev -32.9 mV); Kdrfast, KvAolm and Nav in soma, dendrites and axon (Nav 10.7/23.4/17.1 mS/cm2); leak 0.01 mS/cm2; Cm 1.3 uF/cm2. Harness: +0.23 nA 50-250 ms. Shipped NEURON reference (NeuroML2/.test.mep, "current clamp olm"): 14 spikes 62.4-250.9 ms, ISI 16.2 -> 14.2 ms (slight acceleration). Its OMV tests use jNeuroML_NEURON and jNeuroML_NetPyNE, not jNeuroML. Not simulated in this sweep.
model.inclusion_reason: Interneuron class absent from the pool, with somatic HCN (sag candidate), and small enough (8 segments) for jLEMS. BLOCKERS/caveats: no licence; not single-compartment; the jNeuroML_NEURON check failed at this commit (jNeuroML_NetPyNE succeeded); personal repository rather than the OSB organisation.
